messages.subject: good news: solid preliminary results with BBVB
parts:
Hey guys,

Finally some good news! We've squished some bugs, both mathematical and computational in nature. I've also been careful with numerical stability. And things seem to work!

I was able to use variational inference to fit the ARD model I had proposed as a testbed for 7 dimensions. This model includes a few transforms, and things didn't explode. (Will continue testing with more complicated models and higher dimensions/bigger data.)

Anyhow. I just wanted to share the progress. More updates to follow in the near future.

Cheers,
Alp
